raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

Every sparse-MLA layer calls the FlashInfer `trtllm_batch_decode_with_kv_cache_mla` wrapper per step with no `out=`. The wrapper re-validates inputs, constructs a fresh `TrtllmGenMlaDecodeRunner` plus `TuningConfig`, runs `AutoTuner.choose_one`, and `torch.empty`s the output (up to 33.5 MB at 4096-row batches), per layer, per step. Under `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` attention is an eager break in the piecewise sections, so prefill-mixed steps re-execute that whole Python chain once per sparse layer, about 12 times per engine step.

The runner bakes no query-shape state, so one runner per layer keyed by the KV cache (data_ptr/shape/dtype/top-k capacity) serves every batch. This launches it directly with `tactic=-1` into a per-layer bf16 output buffer sliced per call, with module-scope imports. The DCP path (`return_lse`) keeps the public wrapper because it needs per-call LSE; the HiSparse mixed-step second call gets an `out_offset` so decode and prefill slices stay disjoint before the concat. Runner construction asserts the same two hard constraints the wrapper enforces (head count, block size). Complements #60070 (the counter buffer kwarg) without overlapping it.

Measured on GLM-5.3-Flash (NVFP4), 8x B300 (SM103), TP8, FP8 KV cache, MTP k=7, 1M context, `vllm bench serve`, random dataset, seed 42, medians of 3 warm runs, patch applied alone:

| workload (1024-in / 1024-out) | TPOT mean | TPOT p99 |
|---|---|---|
| 8 concurrent | 5.40 -> 4.82 ms (-10.7%) | 8.26 -> 7.07 ms (-14.4%) |
| 32 concurrent | 7.85 -> 6.74 ms (-14.1%) | 12.24 -> 12.14 ms (-0.8%) |
| 32K prompt, 64 out | 7.96 -> 7.59 ms (-4.6%) | 8.13 -> 8.10 ms |
| 512K prompt, 64 out | 4.32 -> 4.10 ms (-5.1%) | 4.32 -> 4.10 ms |

Medians of 3 warm passes within one boot per arm; across reboots of the unpatched build, c8 and c32 TPOT varied by roughly 25% and 12% on this setup, so the smaller deltas are directional and the workload-level trend is the signal. Spec-dec acceptance rates were not separately instrumented; the win is attributed to the removed launch-path work, not to acceptance changes.

 from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, ClassVar
 
 import torch
+from flashinfer.decode import trtllm_batch_decode_with_kv_cache_mla
+from flashinfer.mla import TrtllmGenMlaDecodeRunner
+from flashinfer.utils import (
+    device_support_pdl,
+    get_device_sm_count,
+    get_trtllm_gen_multi_ctas_kv_counter_bytes,
+)
 
 from vllm import envs
-from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig, get_current_vllm_config
 from vllm.config.cache import CacheDType
 from vllm.logger import init_logger
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.sparse_mla_attention import (
@@ -483,6 +490,19 @@ def __init__(
         # for query and kv_cache (mixed bf16+fp8 is not supported).
         self.supports_quant_query_input = True
 
+        # Persistent launch state for the no-LSE decode path; the wrapper
+        # rebuilds runner/tuning/output per call.
+        self._mqa_runner: TrtllmGenMlaDecodeRunner | None = None
+        self._mqa_runner_key: tuple[int, torch.Size, torch.dtype, int] | None = None
+        self._mqa_out: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        # Caller-owned multi-CTA-KV counter. The runner otherwise regrows its
+        # own counter on a larger batch, freeing the buffer that captured CUDA
+        # graphs still reference.
+        self._mqa_counter: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        self._mqa_counter_max_rows = (
+            get_current_vllm_config().scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens
+        )
+
     def forward_mqa(
         self,
         q: torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor],
@@ -566,6 +586,8 @@ def forward_mqa(
                 prefill_cache,
                 prefill_indices,
                 prefill_lens,
+                # Keep decode/prefill output slices disjoint before concat.
+                out_offset=num_decode_tokens,
             )
             if decode_out is None:
                 return prefill_out, prefill_lse
@@ -624,6 +646,86 @@ def _prepare_mqa_kernel(
             if is_quantized_kv_cache(self.kv_cache_dtype):
                 self.bmm2_scale *= layer._k_scale_float
 
+    def _get_mqa_out(self, query: torch.Tensor, out_offset: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        num_rows = query.size(0)
+        if self._mqa_out is None or self._mqa_out.size(0) < out_offset + num_rows:
+            assert self.topk_indices_buffer is not None
+            max_rows = max(out_offset + num_rows, self.topk_indices_buffer.size(0))
+            # Kernel writes bf16 regardless of query dtype.
+            self._mqa_out = torch.empty(
+                (max_rows, 1, self.num_heads, self.kv_lora_rank),
+                dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                device=query.device,
+            )
+        return self._mqa_out[out_offset : out_offset + num_rows]
+
+    def _get_mqa_counter(self, query: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        num_rows, num_heads = query.size(0), query.size(2)
+        sm_count = get_device_sm_count(query.device)
+        if self._mqa_counter is None:
+            # Sized for the worst case on the first (eager) call, before any
+            # CUDA graph capture, so it never needs to grow.
+            max_rows = max(self._mqa_counter_max_rows, num_rows)
+            self._mqa_counter = torch.zeros(
+                get_trtllm_gen_multi_ctas_kv_counter_bytes(
+                    max_rows, num_heads, sm_count
+                ),
+                dtype=torch.uint8,
+                device=query.device,
+            )
+        required = get_trtllm_gen_multi_ctas_kv_counter_bytes(
+            num_rows, num_heads, sm_count
+        )
+        if required > self._mqa_counter.numel():
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"Sparse MLA batch of {num_rows} rows exceeds the multi-CTA-KV "
+                f"counter sized for {self._mqa_counter_max_rows} rows."
+            )
+        return self._mqa_counter
+
+    def _get_mqa_runner(
+        self, kv_cache: torch.Tensor, sparse_topk_capacity: int
+    ) -> TrtllmGenMlaDecodeRunner:
+        kv_cache = kv_cache.unsqueeze(1)
+        key = (
+            kv_cache.data_ptr(),
+            kv_cache.shape,
+            kv_cache.dtype,
+            sparse_topk_capacity,
+        )
+        if self._mqa_runner is None or self._mqa_runner_key != key:
+            if 64 < self.num_heads < 128:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "trtllm-gen MLA decode does not support "
+                    f"64 < num_heads < 128; got num_heads={self.num_heads}."
+                )
+            page_size = kv_cache.size(2)
+            if page_size not in (32, 64):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"trtllm-gen requires block_size in (32, 64), got {page_size}."
+                )
+            self._mqa_runner = TrtllmGenMlaDecodeRunner(
+                kv_cache=kv_cache,
+                workspace_buffer=self._workspace_buffer,
+                sm_count=get_device_sm_count(kv_cache.device),
+                qk_nope_head_dim=self.qk_nope_head_dim,
+                kv_lora_rank=self.kv_lora_rank,
+                qk_rope_head_dim=self.qk_rope_head_dim,
+                max_seq_len=sparse_topk_capacity,
+                sparse_mla_top_k=sparse_topk_capacity,
+                bmm1_scale=self.bmm1_scale,
+                bmm2_scale=self.bmm2_scale,
+                sinks=None,
+                skip_softmax_threshold_scale_factor=None,
+                enable_pdl=device_support_pdl(kv_cache.device),
+                is_var_seq=True,
+                uses_shared_paged_kv_idx=True,
+                return_lse=False,
+                lse=None,
+            )
+            self._mqa_runner_key = key
+        return self._mqa_runner
+
     def autotune_hisparse_decode(self, layer: AttentionLayer) -> None:
         """Autotune the largest legal HiSparse decode batch."""
         assert isinstance(self.index_group, HiSparseMLAIndexGroup)
@@ -673,13 +775,13 @@ def _run_mqa_kernel(

     ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
         assert self._workspace_buffer is not None
         assert self.bmm1_scale is not None
         assert self.bmm2_scale is not None
